shortDescription: Aster DM Quality Care is planning to open its upcoming 300-bed multispeciality Aster Hospital in Kondapur here in March 2027.With the addition of the new facility being developed with an investment of ₹500 crore, the Group’s total bed capacity in Hyderabad will exceed 1,700 beds.

children: Aster DM Quality Care is planning to open its upcoming 300-bed multispeciality Aster Hospital in Kondapur here in March 2027.
With the addition of the new facility being developed with an investment of ₹500 crore, the Group’s total bed capacity in Hyderabad will exceed 1,700 beds.

title: Aster DM Quality Care to open new multispeciality hospital in Hyderabad’s Kondapur
